summary: Tencent Music Entertainment Group filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the September 11, 2026 closing of a registered public offering of US$1,000 million aggregate principal amount of senior unsecured notes, split evenly between US$500 million of 5.050% notes due 2031 and US$500 million of 5.650% notes due 2036. Net proceeds were approximately US$991.9 million after underwriting discounts and estimated expenses, intended for general corporate purposes including refinancing offshore indebtedness and share repurchases. Joint bookrunners were J.P. Morgan, Goldman Sachs (Asia) and HSBC, with UBS, Bank of China and MUFG as joint lead managers; notes are expected to list on HKEX. This is a routine debt capital-markets takedown off an automatic Form F-3 shelf, not a special situation. Watch for use of proceeds toward buybacks and any subsequent leverage or capital-return signaling.
